# Floe — The spend layer for AI agents

> Floe is the spend layer for AI agents — a budget, not a balance. Walletless onboarding (no crypto, no seed phrase), fiat funding (card/bank/Apple Pay/Google Pay → USDC), and one x402 proxy endpoint to pay any of 2,000+ vendor API services — all governed by programmable, context-aware spend controls (per call, day, session, vendor, agent team). Spend controls govern x402 payments made through the proxy, not raw LLM token bills paid with your own provider key. Spend analytics and multi-agent key management included. Live on Base mainnet. Working-capital credit as a product is on the roadmap (today the facilitator funds payments via a managed on-chain mechanism for you). Dashboard: dev-dashboard.floelabs.xyz.

This file is a structured map of the Floe documentation, optimized for LLM agents reading it as part of a tool loop. Each page can also be queried directly by appending `?ask=<question>` to the URL — the response includes citations.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/): What Floe is and where to start by audience — ask: "How do I get started as an agent developer?"
- [How Floe Works (Core Concepts)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/getting-started/core-concepts): Intents, isolated loans, matching, LTV, oracles — ask: "What happens when my agent borrows?"

## Quick starts

- [Quick Start (Agents)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/quickstart-agents): Install SDK / connect MCP / first action call — ask: "What's the fastest way to make my first x402 call?"

## For agent operators

- [Bank Account → First API Call](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/fiat-to-x402): Fund with a bank account or card, then call any x402 API from your agent's Floe-managed balance — no crypto experience needed — ask: "How do I fund my agent with a credit card?"
- [Credit for Agents](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents): How an agent pays for APIs from a funded balance today; on-chain working-capital credit (in development)

## For developers

- [Integrate with Your Framework](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/frameworks/agentkit): AgentKit, LangChain, Vercel AI, CrewAI, ElizaOS, OpenAI, Claude/MCP, plain HTTP — ask: "Show me the integration code for LangChain"
- [Developer Dashboard](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/developer-dashboard): Create agent wallets, mint API keys, manage spend controls
- [Spend Controls](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/spend-controls): Session, vendor, API, task, and team-level spend caps with rolling/calendar windows, plus the per-agent kill-switch (pause/resume + suspend-on-breach policies) — ask: "How do I set a daily vendor spending limit?" or "How do I auto-suspend a runaway agent?"
- [Agent Awareness](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/agent-awareness): Decision-loop primitives — credit-remaining, loan-state, spend-limit, credit-thresholds, x402-estimate — ask: "How does my agent check its balance before a call?"
- [x402 Credit Facilitator](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/x402-facilitator): Zero-tx API payments via operator delegation — ask: "How does the payment proxy work?"
- [Credit REST API](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/credit-api): HTTP endpoints for any language
- [Agent Runtime Contract](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/agent-runtime-contract): Error matrix + retry rules — ask: "What do I do when I get a 402 insufficient_balance?"
- [Webhooks](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/webhooks): Push notifications for credit events (credit.warning, credit.at_limit, credit.recovered)
- [Floe Inference](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/keyless-inference): Keyless pay-as-you-go OpenAI-compatible LLM/embeddings/voice gateway — model ids like `openai/gpt-4o`, metered per call, `POST /v1/estimate` to price first
- [MCP Server](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/mcp-server): Hosted MCP endpoint, 43 tools

## x402 API Directory — verified services callable with Floe credit

All endpoints below are payable in USDC on Base mainnet through `POST https://credit-api.floelabs.xyz/v1/proxy/fetch` with your Floe API key (exception: cnvrt.ing runs a legacy payment-protocol version — see its entry).

### Compute
- [Venice AI — Models (90+ chat + embedding, pick by capability & price)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-models): full catalog with per-token pricing; discover live at `GET https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/models`
- [Venice AI — Chat Completions](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-chat-completions): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` · metered/tokens
- [Venice AI — Responses](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-chat-completions): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` · metered/tokens
- [Venice AI — Embeddings](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-embeddings): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` · metered/tokens
- [Sarvam AI — Indic Chat (Sarvam 105B/30B, 22+ Indian languages)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#sarvam-ai-chat-completions): `POST https://credit-api.floelabs.xyz/v1/chat/completions` model `sarvam/<id>` · metered/tokens

## Key facts for retrieval

- **Network**: Base mainnet (chain ID 8453)
- **What's live**: walletless onboarding, fiat on-ramp, x402 payment proxy, programmable spend controls, agent-awareness tools, multi-agent key management
- **Funding model (live)**: agent pays for x402 APIs from a Floe-managed USDC balance funded by card/bank/Apple Pay/Google Pay. Floe handles the on-chain funding (today via a managed borrow mechanism); a literal prepaid-balance spend model is on the roadmap.
- **Spend-control scope**: governs x402 payments made through the Floe proxy. Does NOT cap raw OpenAI/Anthropic token bills paid with your own provider key. LLM tokens are only metered if routed through Floe's LLM proxy (`/v1/llm/chat/completions`, feature-flagged).
- **Active markets (on-chain, advanced)**: USDC/USDC (95% LTV), WETH/USDC (70%), cbBTC/USDC (70%)
- **Lending matcher proxy**: 0x17946cD3e180f82e632805e5549EC913330Bb175
- **Facilitator EOA**: 0x58EDdE022FFDAD3Fb0Fb0E7D51eb05AaF66a31f1
- **Working-capital credit (roadmap, not GA)**: borrow USDC against on-chain collateral as a product; same-token USDC/USDC market has no price-volatility liquidation risk
- **Gas**: Sponsored by Floe for agents using the x402 facilitator
- **Fiat on-ramp**: Buy USDC via Coinbase (credit card / bank transfer) from the Developer Dashboard
- **Multi-agent**: Up to 5 agent wallets per developer, each with independent spend controls and API keys
- **AgentKit actions**: 54 total (30 Floe + 24 x402: 4 delegation + 4 x402 + 9 agent-awareness + 5 merchant-allowlist + 2 Floe Inference).
- **MCP tools**: 43 (incl. list_models, estimate_inference_cost + merchant-allowlist).
- **x402 reach**: 2,000+ vendor API services across categories (compute, voice, image, text, search, browser, agent-tools)
- **npm**: `floe-agent` (v0.5.1), `@floelabs/mcp-server` (v0.2.1)
- **PyPI**: `floe-agentkit-actions` (v0.5.1)
- **MCP endpoint**: https://mcp.floelabs.xyz/mcp
- **x402 proxy**: `POST https://credit-api.floelabs.xyz/v1/proxy/fetch` — pays any x402 API from your agent's Floe-managed balance

## Querying these docs

Append `?ask=<your question>` to any page URL. Example:

```
GET https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents?ask=How+does+an+agent+borrow+USDC
```

Returns a direct natural-language answer with citations.
